events.title: Fed Rate Hike Expectations
events.summary: The Federal Reserve is expected to raise interest rates due to high inflation. This will impact the economy and stock market. Treasury yields have risen in anticipation of the rate hike.
events.reasoning: The expected rate hike will lead to a decrease in stock prices and an increase in bond prices. Investors should short the S&P 500 and buy long-term Treasury bonds.
events.exitStrategy: Exit when the Fed announces the rate hike

gains.conservativeNote: If the rate hike is 25 basis points
gains.extendedNote: If the rate hike is 50 basis points or more

events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The conflict in Iran is escalating, leading to increased tensions in the Middle East. This will impact oil prices and the stock market.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the conflict will lead to increased oil prices and a decrease in stock prices. Investors should buy the S&P 500 and short oil.
events.exitStrategy: Exit when the conflict is resolved
